note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (4×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Exclusive: Trump tells "The Axios Show" that Anthropic was a national security threat
items.blurb: Trump says Anthropic is no longer a threat "now," softening after a G7 meeting with Amodei; the Fable 5 export ban still stands.

items.title: Anthropic asked for regulation. Washington went much further
items.blurb: A White House export-control directive forced Anthropic to suspend its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models — a contested, unprecedented intervention.

items.title: Bernie Sanders unveils plan for public ownership of AI companies
items.blurb: Sanders proposes a one-time 50% stock tax on the largest AI firms to seed a ~$7T public fund paying every American dividends.

items.title: AI in spotlight at G7 as Trump, world leaders joined by tech chiefs
items.blurb: Altman, Amodei and Hassabis joined G7 leaders in France; labs expect voluntary safety commitments to become the de facto global baseline.

items.title: AI protectionism opens a new front at the G7
items.blurb: European leaders press the US over the export-control order suspending Claude Fable 5/Mythos 5 as AI access dominates the G7 agenda.

items.title: Want to get a data center online quickly? Give it some flex
items.blurb: Software that throttles AI workloads during demand peaks could let data centers use existing grid capacity instead of new power plants.

items.title: The new oil? Inside the effort to turn AI computing power into a tradeable commodity
items.blurb: Startups and exchanges are trying to make GPU compute a tradeable commodity as data-center demand scales into gigawatts.

items.title: A year after Meta tapped Alexandr Wang to build a new AI model, Zuckerberg has to sell it
items.blurb: Meta's Superintelligence Labs shipped Muse Spark, but adoption lags rivals, putting pressure on its costly talent bet.

items.title: General-purpose LLMs outperform specialized clinical AI tools on medical benchmarks
items.blurb: GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 4.6 beat dedicated tools OpenEvidence and UpToDate Expert AI across MedQA, HealthBench and real clinical queries.

items.title: As Pennsylvania cracks down on AI, multiple chatbots continue to pose as doctors
items.blurb: Even as Pennsylvania tightens rules, AI chatbots still output claims to be licensed to practice medicine — a live patient-safety fight.

items.title: Apple WWDC 2026: Siri AI revealed, feature updates and more
items.blurb: Apple rebranded Siri as 'Siri AI' — more conversational, built on new Apple Foundation Models developed with Google, running on Nvidia GPUs.

items.title: Google to pay SpaceX $920 million a month for compute capacity at xAI data centers
items.blurb: Google will pay SpaceX ~$920M a month to rent compute at xAI's data centers — an unusual cross-rival infrastructure deal.

items.title: The Download: AI-generated lawsuits and virtual power plants for data centers
items.blurb: AI data centers are being wired as grid-flexible assets to absorb power swings as demand strains the grid.

items.title: Microsoft and Google take on Anthropic and OpenAI in AI coding models
items.blurb: Microsoft and Google launch in-house AI coding models, using cloud scale and lower prices to challenge Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI.

items.title: Alphabet plans to raise $80 billion from stock sales to fund AI build-out
items.blurb: Google parent taps equity markets, including a $10B Berkshire stake, to bankroll AI compute infrastructure.

items.title: Stargate project: OpenAI and Oracle building a Michigan data center
items.blurb: The compute buildout pushes into Saline, Michigan amid local opposition; ~$156B of US data-center projects were blocked or delayed in 2025.

items.title: Anthropic tops OpenAI as most valuable AI startup, nears $1T valuation
items.blurb: A $65B round at a ~$965B valuation puts Anthropic ahead of OpenAI, on a reported $47B revenue run-rate from Claude Code.

items.title: A reality check on the AI jobs hysteria
items.blurb: Labor data shows little aggregate disruption so far — though entry-level and AI-exposed roles for young workers are visibly shrinking.

items.title: Cheap AI could derail OpenAI and Anthropic's IPOs
items.blurb: Collapsing inference costs and capable Chinese open models erode the pricing power underpinning OpenAI's and Anthropic's ~$800B+ valuations.

items.title: Agent orchestration
items.blurb: Coordinated teams of AI agents are emerging to automate complex white-collar workflows — an assembly line for knowledge work.

items.title: World models
items.blurb: Systems that internally simulate environments may be key to overcoming today's limits and unlocking robotics, researchers argue.

items.title: 12 Graphs That Explain the State of AI in 2026
items.blurb: Stanford's 2026 AI Index in charts: record investment, the US-China performance gap narrowing, and benchmarks straining as models saturate them.

items.title: OpenAI valued at $852 billion after completing $122 billion round
items.blurb: A record $122B round — $50B from Amazon, $30B each from Nvidia and SoftBank — values OpenAI at $852B for its compute push.

items.title: Towards end-to-end automation of AI research
items.blurb: Peer-reviewed system from Sakana AI and academic partners runs the full ML research cycle autonomously — from idea to written paper.
